wiki.summary: “my way” is sixth track off of you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love. Similar to songs like “Better Than Revenge” by Taylor Swift and Misery Business by Paramore, Olivia angrily yearns about a girl crossing boundaries in her relationship with her boyfriend. Read more on Last.fm.
